<hbox pack="end">
              <!-- This button should have identical attributes to the
             server.popAdvancedButton except the hidefor attribute. -->
              <button
                id="server.ewsAdvancedButton"
                label="&advancedButton.label;"
                accesskey="&advancedButton.accesskey;"
                oncommand="onAdvanced()"
                wsm_persist="true"
                prefstring="mail.server.%serverkey%.advanced.disable"
                hidefor="pop3,nntp,imap"
              />
            </hbox>
          </vbox>

          <!-- Advanced EWS settings -->
          <hbox flex="1" hidefor="pop3,nntp,imap" hidden="hidden">
            <label id="ews.exchangeUrl" wsm_persist="true" hidden="hidden" />
            <checkbox
              id="ews.exchangeOverrideOAuthDetails"
              wsm_persist="true"
              prefattribute="value"
              prefstring="mail.server.%serverkey%.ews_override_oauth_details"
              hidden="hidden"
